definitions.explanation: Music performed in person by musicians at the venue, as opposed to recorded or synthesized music. Valued for its immediacy and authenticity.

examples.japanese: {生演奏|なまえんそう}を{聴|き}く。
このレストランでは{毎晩|まいばん}ジャズの{生演奏|なまえんそう}がある。
examples.english: This restaurant has live jazz every evening.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}で{友人|ゆうじん}がピアノの{生演奏|なまえんそう}をしてくれて、とても{感動|かんどう}した。
examples.english: A friend played live piano at the wedding, and it was very moving.

notes:
USAGE:
The prefix {生|なま} (live, raw) distinguishes this from recorded music. {生演奏|なまえんそう} can refer to any genre — classical, jazz, rock, etc. Common at restaurants, hotels, wedding receptions, and concert venues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生演奏|なまえんそう}を{聴|き}く (to listen to a live performance)
- {生演奏|なまえんそう}つき (with live music)
- {生演奏|なまえんそう}で{歌|うた}う (to sing with live accompaniment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ライブ: live concert — typically refers to a pop or rock concert event
- {演奏|えんそう}: musical performance — does not specify whether live or recorded
